name: 31015 · Cordele, GA
findings: ZIP 31015 (Cordele) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31015 (Cordele) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
64% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31015 (Cordele) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
